run_build_trace_react: run build_trace_react.py to process episode traces and save filtered samples to an output directory
run_process_directory: run process_directory to extract assistant traces from successful episodes above a percent complete threshold
run_extract_assistant_text_end: run extract_assistant_text_end to find end indices of assistant message blocks in tokenized text
